architecture.summary: S2-01a adds an optional hosted PostgreSQL datastore and its tenant-scoped settings contract to the existing logging owner. The pg adapter uses atomic expected-revision writes, preserves exact no-op revisions, and reports uncertain writes without retry. A bounded runtime owns lazy verified-TLS connections, active and pending work, acquisition and query deadlines, and local socket cleanup. Hosted composition reads separate server-only database/key/CA settings, keeps unavailable storage outside MCP admission and health, and starts SQL and MCP cleanup together. PostgreSQL can complete already-submitted work after local socket close, bounded by its server statement timeout. Local edition composition does not load the hosted SQL adapter. The SQL migration defines a restricted server role and private forced-RLS table, but no live project migration or rollout occurs. Logging UI, credential encryption and export remain later tickets. Existing WorkOS identity authority, browser/MCP organization binding, and provider contract behavior stay unchanged. Registry container, component and deployment views now show this optional boundary and lifetime; all other views were checked. Exact pg and Node builtin facts and a dedicated local PostgreSQL gate are declared without weaker thresholds or test selection. The durable contract and resource lifetime require T2 architect review. No architecture decision record is introduced. The final hosted image probe uses synthetic storage settings under disabled networking to verify packaged adapter loading and lazy cleanup; its strict error logger remains unchanged.
